source: Heal.onStart(effector, effected, skill) (handlers/skill/effects/Heal.java, the real effect object of the skill) and Formulas.calcMCrit
note: The effect runs for real on the creatures: effected.setCurrentHp(hp_before), onStart, hp_after - hp_before is the healed amount (result). The number part is power + static shot bonus + sqrt(mAtkMul * mAtk), x HEAL_EFFECT stat, x class balance (1), x3 on a magic crit (calcMCrit(effector.getMCriticalHit) draws Rnd.get(1000) for magic, non-static skills), capped by max recoverable HP - current HP. shots = the effector's charged shots when the case ran (spiritshots need a weapon). effect_power is the 'power' param of the skill's Heal effect (read by reflection). Static skills (potions) skip the whole stat part: amount = power, no draw. Every case has 'script' (the unit values u in [0,1) that were consumed) and 'rnd' (every Rnd call in order: method, bound, returned value; get_int bound b returns floor(u*b), get_int_range o,b returns o+floor(u*(b-o+1)), nextGaussian is 2u-1 in the harness). Calls that draw nothing are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound.
